findings.summary: Program 013 did not freeze a restart-safe one-use protocol for its own provider requests.
findings.evidence: The proposal required one frontier request and no reissue but omitted the exclusive root lock, durable claim, create-only fsynced pre-transport intent, response receipt before parsing, and terminal handling for ambiguous checkpoints.
findings.required_correction: Freeze the exact Program 013 restart contract, bind the first new intent to the rederived predecessor frontier, and require crash and two-process regression coverage.

findings.summary: Program 013 did not freeze a redacted public terminal and pre-credential revocation contract.
findings.evidence: The proposal required terminal evidence without defining the public path, schema, allowlist, create-only publication, or lifecycle rejection behavior.
findings.required_correction: Freeze the public terminal projection, private-field exclusions, create-only publication, re-entry behavior, and terminal closeout guard.

findings.summary: Program 013 reset transport and disk ceilings instead of enforcing the inherited limits cumulatively.
findings.evidence: The proposal granted the full Program 012 request, response-byte, and disk budgets to new Program 013 work despite reusing a nonempty predecessor prefix.
findings.required_correction: Derive private remaining allowances from validated Program 012 evidence and enforce predecessor plus successor use at or below every inherited cap.

findings.summary: The required predecessor import manifest had no frozen content or identity contract.
findings.evidence: The proposal did not bind the predecessor authority, ordered page identities, exact contiguous whole-session prefix, frontier identity, or combined private dataset identity.
findings.required_correction: Define the private import-manifest schema and bind it into the combined private dataset identity while keeping all dynamic values private.

scope_limit: The review made no credential access, provider request, private market-data read, strategy calculation, controlled or protected read, PAPER action, broker write, live action, or purchase.
required_next_action: Preserve proposal v1, issue a prospective v2 correction for all four findings, and obtain fresh design and security-boundary reviews before implementation.
